cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only clearing the table. I'll leave this timetable out: three buses I missed waiting for you to bring my keys back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three circles. I'll put the takeaway receipt beside it, from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry and I'll clear the lot; otherwise I'll need this end of the table to show you where the evening went.
